title: 2025 Trend Report | Free Highlights
notes: Free highlights page, first archived 2024-12-05 (published on or before that date). Prints four trends 'reshaping business in 2025'. The full 2025 Trend Report ('including many more trends and exclusive tools') is for paying members only, so the edition is partial: the free excerpt is complete, the report is not. The highlights PDF (hubfs/trendwatching-2025trendreport-highlights.pdf) was not read. target_year 2025 from the title.

entries.label: LOOPLIFE
entries.quote: Now, brands will put it to work to bridge that persistent say-do gap and make circular living frictionless.
entries.subject: AI-enabled circular consumption
entries.note: Subtitle: 'AI solutions simplify and normalize the shift to circularity'. 'It' is AI. The intro cites climate change as the top global risk (63% of experts, 45% of the public); present figures.

entries.label: SENSESCAPING
entries.quote: The quest for wellness remains a powerful driver of consumer behavior, but in 2025 the path to enlightenment will intersect with a growing interest in personalized experiences
entries.subject: Personalized sensory and emotional-data experiences
entries.note: Subtitle: 'Sensory experiences reveal inner truths'. The sentence continues with a Deloitte figure (personalized experiences up 20% between 2022 and 2024); past data, not recorded as metric.

entries.label: WORTHWISE
entries.quote: 2025 will see new models for creating and capturing worth emerge.
entries.subject: New forms of value exchange and loyalty
entries.note: Subtitle: 'Rethinking how worth is generated and exchanged'.

entries.label: HUMANIFESTO
entries.quote: As algorithmic, AI-centric content and ads start flooding the ether, many are pushing back and embracing the real – in all its messiness.
entries.subject: Human imperfection as a reaction to AI content
entries.note: Subtitle: 'Celebrating messiness in the age of AI'.
